zh: 剛開始在遠處，漸漸地響起來的腳步聲。^@
en: Footsteps, distant at first, slowly growing louder.^@

zh: ^%馬克芬德：^0　………有人走過來了。^$　一個………兩個………三個、是往常的那些人吧？^0　……拜託你們，今天總該輪到我了吧？^0　快呀～快把我給殺了吧！……………^\
en: ^%Markfiend:^0  ...Someone's coming.^$  One... two... three. The usual lot, I suppose?^0  ...Come on. Surely it's my turn today?^0  Hurry up! Come on, just kill me already!...^\

zh: ^%蜜爾芮：^0　「求求你們、放我出去吧！好心的大人！如果沒有我的話，^0　　我的爸媽會……求、求求你們～……」^@
en: ^%Mirlei:^0  "Please, let me out! Please, kind sir! Without me,^0  my mother and father will... P-please, I beg you..."^@

zh: ^%馬克芬德：^0　　這些話從先前就聽到現在，成天到晚還說不厭！真是…^0　　妳呀、運氣太背了，我看只有死路一條啦～……………^\
en: ^%Markfiend:^0  Same words, over and over, all day long, and you^0  never tire of it! Honestly... Your luck's run out.^0  Looks like death is the only road left to you...^\

zh: ^%守衛：^0　「這娘們每天可真吵！還不給我乖乖的老實一點！」^\
en: ^%Guard:^0  "This wench never shuts up! Pipe down and behave!"^\

zh: ^%蜜爾芮：^0　「我是無辜的！求求你放我出去好嗎？！」^\
en: ^%Mirlei:^0  "I'm innocent! Please, won't you let me out?!"^\

zh: ^%守衛：^0　「咈咈咈、我看妳乾脆死了這條心算了吧！要不然給我說實^0　　話，就說『我企圖用邪惡的魔法詛咒國王』，怎麼樣啊？^0　　說嘛、只要妳肯說，就讓你死得快活一點，怎麼樣？」^\
en: ^%Guard:^0  "Heh, heh, heh. Better give up on that right now! Or^0  else tell me the truth. Say 'I tried to curse the^0  king with black magic.' How about it? Go on, just say^0  it, and I'll let you die nice and quick. Well?"^\

zh: ^%蜜爾芮：^0　「我、我………什麼事也沒做。放我出去、求求你！^\
en: ^%Mirlei:^0  "I, I... I didn't do anything. Let me out, please!"^\

zh: ^%馬克芬德：^0　……看來妳好像非出去不可的樣子……唉、真拿你沒輒！^\
en: ^%Markfiend:^0  ...Seems she has to get out... Sigh. What a pain.^\

zh: ^%守衛：^0　「唷、妳這麼想離開這裡呀？好～我就把妳給弄出來！^0　　嘿、嘿、嘿……！」^\
en: ^%Guard:^0  "Oh, you want out that badly? Fine, I'll get you out!^0  Heh, heh, heh...!"^\
^%Mirlei:^0  "Eeeek!!"^@
^%Guard:^0  "Waaaugh!!"^0  "Wh-what are... what are you doing?!"^0  "Aaaagh!!!"^\
^%Markfiend:^0  "Move!"^\

zh: ^%馬克芬德：^0　「妳想在那待到什麼時候？……妳想出去不是嗎？^0　　還是改變主意了？^0　　好～吧、想死就繼續待在那兒吧。」^@
en: ^%Markfiend:^0  "How long are you going to sit there? You wanted out,^0  didn't you? Or have you changed your mind?^0  Fine. If you want to die, stay right there."^@
^%Mirlei:^0  "...Ah! W-wait for me...!"^\

zh: ^%馬克芬德：^0　……等我把這女的弄到上面之後，就可以靜靜地死了……。^\
en: ^%Markfiend:^0  ...Once I get this girl up top, I can die in peace...^\

zh: 爬上階梯的盡頭處，馬克芬德忽然感受到一陣不可思議的呼喚^0聲。回過頭來，只見身旁不遠豎立著一座傾頹腐朽的石像。^@
en: At the top of the stairs, Markfiend suddenly heard a^0strange voice calling him. He turned to find a^0crumbling, decayed statue standing not far away.^@

zh: ^%石像：^0　我有話對你說。^@
en: ^%Statue:^0  I would speak with you.^@

zh: ^%馬克芬德：^0　「石、石像會說話？！」^@
en: ^%Markfiend:^0  "A-a talking statue?!"^@

zh: ^%石像：^0　　我們是被一個擁有強大法力的人由魔界強迫召喚到這個世^0　　上的妖魔。^0　　那個人要求我們成為他永遠的僕從、不應允者就施以古代^0　　的儀式加以封印。^@
en: ^%Statue:^0  We are demons, summoned by force from the Demon Realm^0  into this world by one who wielded great power.^0  He demanded that we serve him forever, and those who^0  refused, he sealed away with an ancient rite.^@

zh: ^%蜜爾芮：^0　　古代儀式的…封印？^@
en: ^%Mirlei:^0  Sealed... by an ancient rite?^@

zh: ^%傾頹的石像：^0　　我們被封閉在這樣的石像裡，已經無術可施。所以能不能^0　　請你運用法力，讓我們從石像中解放開來，再次成為自由^0　　之身呢？^@
en: ^%Crumbling Statue:^0  Shut inside these statues, we are powerless. Would^0  you use your power to release us from the stone, so^0  that we may be free once more?^@

zh: ^%馬克芬德：^0　「將你們從石像中解放開來？……你是說、要同你們簽下契^0　　約是嗎？」^@
en: ^%Markfiend:^0  "Release you from the statue? ...You mean you want me^0  to make a pact with you?"^@

zh: ^%傾頹的石像：^0　　咈咈…看來能夠駕御統領我們魔族的那個人，恐怕不會是^0　　你這個不解世故的傢伙了…^$　　如果你能讓我們從這令人厭惡的石像中解放，只要你呼喚^0　　我們就會立即應聲而現。契約什麼的根本不用！^@
en: ^%Crumbling Statue:^0  Heh heh... The one who commands our kind will not be^0  a green youth like you, it seems...^$  But free us from this loathsome statue, and we will^0  appear the moment you call. No pact is needed!^@

zh: ^%傾頹的石像：^0　　……你也不需要急著回答我們的請求。只要…以接下來的^0　　實際行動向我們示意就可以了……。^$　　我已經把話傳達給你，一切就看你了。^\
en: ^%Crumbling Statue:^0  ...Nor need you hasten to answer our plea. It is^0  enough that you show us your answer... through your^0  deeds from this day on...^$  I have said what I had to say. The rest is up to you.^\

zh: ^%士兵：^0　「大事不好了！從地牢脫逃的兩個人為了回到地面上，已經^0　　朝著我們這個地方來了！」^@
en: ^%Soldier:^0  "We've got trouble! The two who escaped from the^0   Dungeon are heading this way, trying to get back to^0   the surface!"^@

zh: ^%傑達恩：^0　「哼！這時候才來報告也太遲了吧。關於這件事，我早就已^0　　經想好了對策。^$　　你們這些白癡最好也趕快離開這裡吧！如果撞上我從地下^0　　第２層放出來的妖魔，牠可不管你是我方還是敵方喔。」^@
en: ^%Jadain:^0  "Hmph! A little late to be reporting that now. I^0   already have a plan for this.^$   And you idiots had better clear out too! If you run^0   into the demon I let loose from the second level, it^0   won't care whether you're friend or foe."^@
^%Soldier:^0  "Y-yes, sir. Understood."^\

zh: 馬克兩人看到通往地面那道綿延不絕的階梯所呈現的情景時，^0不禁啞然。^$整道階梯已經遭到壓倒性的力量給崩塌成兩半，變成無論是誰^0都沒辦法越過的斷崖殘壁了。^@
en: Mark and Mirlei stood speechless at the sight of the^0long stair leading up to the surface.^$An overwhelming force had split the whole stair in two,^0leaving a sheer broken cliff that no one could cross.^@

zh: ^%馬克芬德：^0　「這、這究竟是怎麼一回事！？」^@
en: ^%Markfiend:^0  "Wh-what the hell is this!?"^@

zh: ^%傑達恩：^0　「咈咈…好好想想這地牢的用意吧。原本就不需要有出口什^0　　麼的不是嗎？^$　　反正…無論是誰被抓到這裡來，早晚都難逃一死的。」^@
en: ^%Jadain:^0  "Heh heh... Think about what this dungeon is for.^0   It never needed an exit, did it?^$   After all... whoever is brought here dies sooner or^0   later anyway."^@

zh: ^%馬克芬德：^0　「你這卑鄙小人！！」^@
en: ^%Markfiend:^0  "You snake!!"^@

zh: ^%傑達恩：^0　「沒錯，毀掉這整座地牢出口是我個人私下的決定，因為雷^0　　薩德大人早就說過…絕～對不能讓你們兩個人活著離開這^0　　裡。不過聰明的你應該知道…並不是所有可以通往外頭的^0　　道路都已經斷絕了。^0　　畢竟…如果連我們也出不去的話，恐怕都得死在這了。」^@
en: ^%Jadain:^0  "Quite right. Wrecking the Dungeon's exit was my own^0   idea, because Lord Lezard made it clear... that you^0   two must never, ever leave here alive. But a clever^0   man like you should know... not every road to the^0   outside has been cut off. After all... if even we^0   couldn't get out, we'd all die down here too."^@

zh: ^%馬克芬德：^0　「………你是說，我們只能往地下走，是嗎？」^@
en: ^%Markfiend:^0  "......So the only way for us is down, is it?"^@

zh: ^%傑達恩：^0　「沒錯！你果然聰明。那裡有我們經常使用的傳送用魔法陣。^0　　只要你使用魔法，就可以藉著這些傳送用的魔法陣，輕易地^0　　離開這個地方。」^@
en: ^%Jadain:^0  "Exactly! Clever, just as I thought. Down there are^0   the warp circles we use all the time. With a little^0   magic, those warp circles will take you out of this^0   place with ease."^@

zh: ^%馬克芬德：^0　「即使我能離開這裡，但是那些馬金泰爾士兵還有囚犯，他們^0　　怎麼辦？」^@
en: ^%Markfiend:^0  "Even if I get out of here, what about the MacIntyre^0   soldiers and the prisoners? What happens to them?"^@

zh: ^%傑達恩：^0　「剛才我早就說過了…。只要是被抓到這裡來的人都得死！！^0　　士兵們和妖魔…也不過是過河卒子罷了。」^@
en: ^%Jadain:^0  "I told you a moment ago... Everyone brought here^0   dies!! The soldiers and the demons... are nothing^0   but pawns."^@

zh: ^%馬克芬德：^0　「你這渾蛋！」^@
en: ^%Markfiend:^0  "You bastard!"^@

zh: ^%傑達恩：^0　「咈咈…沒時間再跟你閒扯了，我會在地底的深處等待你們的^0　　大駕光臨的…哈哈哈哈！！」^@
en: ^%Jadain:^0  "Heh heh... I've no more time to chat with you. I'll^0   be waiting for the pleasure of your company in the^0   depths below... Ha ha ha ha!!"^@
^%Markfiend:^0  ?!^\

zh: ^%蜜爾芮：^0　「我們…還有路可走是嗎…？如果是這樣的話，我還是會跟著^0　　你一起走……。請你帶著我出去…。」^\
en: ^%Mirlei:^0  "So there's... still a way out...? Then I'll go^0   with you... Please take me out of here..."^\

zh: 呈現在馬克芬德眼前的一座等身大小的女性雕像，發出了不可^0思議的光芒。^0看樣子好像是感應到什麼東西似的，連蜜爾芮的內心也同樣產^0生了相似的感覺。^\
en: Before Markfiend's eyes, a life-size statue of a woman^0gave off a strange light.^0It seemed to be reacting to something, and Mirlei felt^0something much the same stir inside her.^\
^%Mirlei:^0  "Ow, it hurts!"^@

zh: ^%馬克芬德：^0　「真奇怪、只要妳越靠近，魔法的反應就變得越強。」^@
en: ^%Markfiend:^0  "Strange. The closer you get, the stronger the magic^0   reacts."^@

zh: ^%蜜爾芮：^0　「幫我…幫我把它拿下來！嗯…、好燙！！」^\
en: ^%Mirlei:^0  "Help me... help me get it off! Ah... it's burning!!"^\
^%Markfiend:^0  "This is...!"^@

zh: ^%蜜爾芮：^0　「啊、請把它還給我！」^@
en: ^%Mirlei:^0  "Ah, please give it back!"^@

zh: ^%馬克芬德：^0　「妳呀～到底是在哪弄到這玩意兒的！看起來不過是普普通^0　　通的戒指嘛，還老是戴在身上，品味也太差了點吧？」^@
en: ^%Markfiend:^0  "Where on earth did you get this thing!? It looks like^0   a plain, ordinary ring, and you wear it all the time?^0   That's pretty poor taste, isn't it?"^@

zh: ^%蜜爾芮：^0　「這並不是一顆普通的戒指…。這顆戒指是個能夠保護我、^0　　對我很重要的……」^@
en: ^%Mirlei:^0  "It isn't an ordinary ring... This ring protects me.^0   It's very precious to me..."^@

zh: ^%馬克芬德：^0　「保護？…哼、如果真的是這樣的話，妳怎麼會跑到這來？」^@
en: ^%Markfiend:^0  "Protects you? ...Hmph. If that were true, how did^0   you end up in here?"^@
^%Mirlei:^0  "That's because......"^@

zh: ^%馬克芬德：^0　「…妳呀妳！這東西是要這麼用的。」^@
en: ^%Markfiend:^0  "...You, honestly! This is how you use the thing."^@

zh: 馬克芬德口中唸著一連串令人感到不可思議的押韻咒文後，戒^0指上逐漸浮現出看起來好像文字又像刮痕的紋樣，同時瞬間產^0生一道白色眩然的光芒包圍著整顆戒指。^@
en: Markfiend chanted a string of strange, rhyming^0incantations. Marks like letters, or perhaps scratches,^0slowly surfaced on the ring, and in an instant a^0dazzling white light wrapped around it.^@

zh: ^%馬克芬德：^0　「這顆戒指本身根本沒有什麼保護人的力量存在。只不過是^0　　以這戒指當做媒介，拿來召喚精靈用的，那時候才叫真正^0　　能保護妳，懂了吧！^$　　好耶、這麼一來…我就不用大費周章召喚那些傢伙啦。真^0　　是萬歲萬歲萬萬歲。」^\
en: ^%Markfiend:^0  "This ring has no power to protect anyone by itself.^0   It's just a medium for summoning spirits. Use it^0   that way, and then it'll really protect you. Got it?^$   Good. Now I don't have to go to the trouble of^0   summoning them myself. Hooray, hooray, three^0   cheers."^\

zh: ^%傑達恩：^0　「……終於來了，不知死活的傢伙。那麼、你們兩個就陪著^0　　我一手造出來的幻影一起跳舞，直到死吧……。」^\
en: ^%Jadain:^0  "...So you've finally come, you reckless fools. Now,^0   the two of you can dance with my phantoms... until^0   you drop dead."^\
^%Mirlei:^0  "It's hot!"^@

zh: 為了躲避迎面襲來的熱氣，低下頭來的蜜爾芮不禁發出了叫聲。^0抬起頭來再看前方時，兩人再次因眼前令人不敢置信的光景發出^0了驚嘆之聲。^@
en: Mirlei cried out as she ducked her head away from the^0heat rushing at them. When they looked ahead again, both^0gasped at the unbelievable sight before them.^@
^%Mirlei:^0  "......A sea of fire!?"^@

zh: 只見周遭全讓一片灼熱的火燄包圍著，彷彿告訴著蜜爾芮，只要^0有人敢踏進這塊領域，絕無生還的機會。^@
en: Searing flames surrounded them on every side, as if^0telling Mirlei that whoever dared step into this place^0would never come out alive.^@

zh: ^%馬克芬德：^0　「……這是用魔法造成的特殊結界。看來傑達恩這小子…好^0　　像不希望咱們能夠通過這地方的樣子。^@
en: ^%Markfiend:^0  "......This is a special barrier made with magic.^0   Looks like that wretch Jadain doesn't want us getting^0   through here."^@

zh: ^%蜜爾芮：^0　「我們…真的要從這裡過去嗎？」^@
en: ^%Mirlei:^0  "Are we... really going through there?"^@

zh: ^%馬克芬德：^0　「對人類而言，想要安全通過這裡是不可能的。看來也只能借用精^0　　靈的力量了。也就是說接下來全靠妳表演啦。^$　　搞得定嗎？這回咱們要召喚的可是上位的高等精靈喔。」^\
en: ^%Markfiend:^0  "No human could get through here safely. We'll have^0   to borrow the power of the spirits. In other words,^0   the rest of the show is yours.^$   Can you handle it? This time we're summoning a^0   spirit of the highest order."^\
^%Mirlei:^0  "...Are you all right?"^@
^%Markfiend:^0  "Mm..."^@

zh: ^%馬克芬德：^0　「妳是什麼時候開始，就擁有這種奇特的力量的？」^@
en: ^%Markfiend:^0  "When did you first have this strange power of yours?"^@
^%Mirlei:^0  "Huh?"^@

zh: ^%馬克芬德：^0　「我是說治療的力量。」^@
en: ^%Markfiend:^0  "The healing power, I mean."^@

zh: ^%蜜爾芮：^0　「什麼…從什麼時候……？」^@
en: ^%Mirlei:^0  "When... since when...?"^@

zh: ^%馬克芬德：^0　「從妳慢慢懂事之後才開始的嗎？」^@
en: ^%Markfiend:^0  "Did it start as you grew old enough to understand?"^@

zh: ^%蜜爾芮：^0　「我也不太清楚…當我發覺自己和別人不太一樣的時候，周^0　　遭的人們就用一種不一樣的態度和我相處了。但、但是從^0　　來沒有人因為我跟人家不一樣，就欺負或歧視我……；相^0　　反的、我應該說…，他們很照顧我也很疼我、只是……。」^@
en: ^%Mirlei:^0  "I don't really know... When I noticed I wasn't quite^0   like everyone else, the people around me began to^0   treat me differently. B-but no one ever bullied me or^0   looked down on me for being different... It was the^0   opposite, I should say... They looked after me and^0   loved me, only......"^@

zh: ^%馬克芬德：^0　「怎麼了？」^@
en: ^%Markfiend:^0  "Only what?"^@

zh: ^%蜜爾芮：^0　「只是我一想到這一生再也不能過著一般人的生活，就會覺^0　　得有點悲傷…………。」^@
en: ^%Mirlei:^0  "Only... when I think that I can never live an^0   ordinary life, I feel a little sad............"^@

zh: ^%馬克芬德：^0　「妳別再說了…。‧‧抱歉、不該問妳的。^0　　振作點，別把它放在心上……。」^\
en: ^%Markfiend:^0  "Don't say any more... Sorry. I shouldn't have asked.^0   Cheer up, and don't let it weigh on you..."^\

zh: ^%馬克芬德：^0　「你這畜生！把咱們國家腐敗的政事全交給國王，你好在這^0　　準備召喚邪神是嗎？^0　　啊～雷薩德．瓦雷斯！」^\
en: ^%Markfiend:^0  "You swine! You leave our kingdom's rotten government^0   to the king so you can sit here preparing to summon^0   an evil god, is that it?^0   Answer me, Lezard Valeth!"^\

zh: ^%雷薩德．瓦雷斯：^0　「你的直覺相當敏銳呀～。不過話說回來，現在的你又是怎^0　　麼一回事呢？　我還記得前不久那個還在嚷嚷著要殺要剮^0　　悉聽尊便的傢伙，今天居然特地跑到我的地方來了！」^@
en: ^%Lezard Valeth:^0  "My, what sharp instincts you have. But tell me, what^0   has come over you now? Not long ago, as I recall, you^0   were the one wailing for us to kill you or carve you^0   up as we pleased. And today you have gone to the^0   trouble of coming all the way to my door!"^@
